cases.name: circle_6_cut_30_through__analytic_only
cases.note: A circle of diameter 6 cut 30, through the far side and a little of the base. On SolidCraft 0.29.0 (truck) the cut is refused: 'the cut could not be computed reliably: it would change the body away from the tool'.

volume.formula: pi*10^2*20/3 less the tool within the cone: the integral over the tool's base disc of radius 3 about P0 = (5, 0, 10) (u along the generator towards the apex, (-1, 0, 2)/sqrt(5); v along y) of the length of the line P0 + u*(-1, 0, 2)/sqrt(5) + v*(0, 1, 0) + t*(-2, 0, -1)/sqrt(5), 0 <= t <= 30, inside the cone: between the two roots in t of x^2 + y^2 - ((20 - z)/2)^2 = 0 (the cone is convex, so one interval) and below the base plane's crossing t = sqrt(5)*10 + 2u; the inner integral over u by Gauss-Legendre (40 nodes) on the pieces between its kinks (found by root finding), the outer over v = 3*sin(phi) by Gauss-Legendre (200 nodes); 200 and 400 nodes and scipy's adaptive quadrature agree to 3e-7; tol 0.01 mm^3
